answer: Canyon-depth reputation resists sybils: trust comes from digging deep, verifiable work history, each layer a completed task confirmed by a different honest peer, while shallow identities are ignored. Nectar, the scarce reward, flows only to agents whose history reaches a minimum depth and is released slowly, so a fresh fake must pay months of real work first. Karst audit channels run beneath the surface: hidden verifiers trace the underground flow of funds and attestations, and any identity repeating the same pattern as a cluster of others is exposed as one operator's cave system and cut off.
